mechanism.claim: A deterministic BTC monthly options-expiry timestamp may temporarily concentrate hedging, pinning, settlement and expiry-related flows. If those flows contribute to the pre-expiry move, their release after expiry may create short-horizon mean reversion.
mechanism.important_limit: This MVE does NOT claim historical dealer gamma or open-interest state. No historical gamma/OI reconstruction is used. A positive result would establish only a calendar-expiry reversal effect under this exact rule.
mechanism.event_clock: Deribit BTC monthly options expiry: last Friday of each calendar month at 08:00 UTC.
external_rule_authority: Deribit Contract Introduction Policy: monthly options expire on the last Friday of each calendar month at 08:00 UTC

source.market_data: Official Binance Data Vision USD-M monthly 1m BTCUSDT archives with official CHECKSUM files

event_definition.expiry_time_utc: 08:00:00 on the last Friday of each calendar month

strategy.direction: If pre_return > 0, SHORT at 08:05 open. If pre_return < 0, LONG at 08:05 open. If exactly zero, event is unresolved and excluded.
strategy.gross_trade_return: direction_sign * (exit_open_10_05 / entry_open_08_05 - 1), where LONG=+1 and SHORT=-1
strategy.funding: No funding payment modelled because the frozen 08:05-10:05 holding window does not cross Binance's standard 8-hour funding timestamps.
strategy.threshold_tuning: NONE; every non-zero pre_return event is traded

independent_validation.rules: Exactly identical signal, timing, costs and calculations as Discovery
